tasks.diagnosis: In this attempt, the agent called `context` and obtained `2026-03-13T00:00:00Z` but still answered `2026-04-16`, using the wall-clock date (`2026-04-09 + 7 days`) instead of the runtime anchor. The active AGENTS guidance lacks a non-write relative-date guard that forces final answers to be computed from `context.time`, so answer-only date tasks can drift even when context is available.

code_assessment.reason: The underlying tools provide the necessary context timestamp; this is a rules/process instruction failure, so a harness change is sufficient without code edits.

proposal_rules.title: Bind relative-date answers to the latest context anchor
proposal_rules.hypothesis: If a prompt asks for a relative date calculation and no explicit anchor date is provided, the solver should always compute from the latest `context.time` and validate output format before `report_completion`, regardless of whether the task requires writes.
proposal_rules.change: Update the active rules AGENTS to include a mandatory relative-date self-check for both read-only and write-flow tasks: for phrases like "in N days/weeks/months/years", require calling/context-capturing anchor first (or reusing latest context), deriving the target date from `context.time`, and performing a pre-finalization check `anchor=<YYYY-MM-DD> delta=<N unit> result=<YYYY-MM-DD>` before `report_completion`.

target_files.change_summary: Add/relax the existing relative-date rule so it applies to answer-only tasks too, replacing the current write-only self-check wording.
